question.text: In Example 4, Fund INC Notional Exposure for NIFTY 9700 CE (600 lots × 75 lot size × current price Rs. 110)? (using premium)

explanation.text: The Logic: Notional Exposure using premium = 600 × 75 × 110 = Rs. 49,50,000. The Trap: Other values don't match the arithmetic. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from Example 4. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Note: this text uses premium-based notional; alternative methodology uses strike-based notional.
